Name: Vegas' Mega Modded Bundles
Author: VegasOctober
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
This is the Mega Modded community center bundle pack you've been looking for.

With required items from 17 different mods, plus quite a few twists and bonuses, this community center mod will completely change your Stardew experience.

[size=4]Gameplay Changes:
[/size]
Core to the game, there is one key change this mod introduces above all others: [b]You get access to Ginger Island before completing the community center[/b].

This not only flips the entire gameplay sequence of Stardew upside down, but it opens up a tremendous amount of content at new and different times. With the additional mods required (below), early access to Ginger Island opens up early access to the Volcano Dungeon, to Qi Quests (and rewards), to Forging and Golden Walnuts and the Island Trader, to SVE's Lance, to The Highlands, to Fable Reef, to Cornucopia's late-game crops and fruit trees, and more. With enough grinding, that is...

This is enabled by just a few very small tweaks, which can be summed up in a single word: [b]Totems[/b].

The Desert Trader now sells warp totems to Ginger Island, as well as the recipe to craft more. This means that many new items are available to be required in the community center, because you can get there now to get them. [b]Cinder Shards, Ginger, Galaxy Souls, Radioactive Ore, and more[/b] are now all required to complete the community center bundles. Not to mention all of the additional content opened up from all of the 17 mods included in this Mega Modded extravaganza!

But you might be wondering, how do I get to the Desert Trader if so many bundles are locked behind end-game items? You'll find there's a new source for the Desert Totems somewhere in the valley, that can help you get exploring all that Stardew has to offer faster. In addition, one of the vendors on Ginger Island offers [b]warp totems to The Highlands[/b], as well as the corresponding recipe, to continue moving you forward and expanding the Stardew world. And a vendor in the Highlands gives can provide you [b]totems for Fable Reef[/b], and the corresponding recipe there as well.

The Highlands and Fable Reef totems are new to this mod, and although they're technically not required, they are designed to get players involved in a huge amount of the Stardew content [i]before[/i] finishing the community center. This really results in the completion of the community center and movie theater being the "end game goal" of Stardew, rather than completion of Ginger Island or unlocking of additional modded areas. It's truly a completely different experience.

Oh ya, and did I mention [b]you can cook Magic Rock Candy[/b], too?

[size=4]Required Mods:[/size]
Ooh boy, here we go...

- Stardew Valley Expanded
- Ridgeside Village
- Lumisteria Visit Mt Vapius
- Sunberry Village
- Lilybrook
- East Scarp
- Alchemistry
- Adventurer's Guild Expanded
- Cornucopia - More Crops
- Cornucopia - More Flowers
- Growable Forage and Crop Bushes (Cornucopia's bushes mod)
- Cornucopia - Artisan Machines
- Wildflour's Atelier Goods
- Sekun's Crop Expansions
- Grains Overhull
- Ilucie's Winter Crops
- Machine Progression System

The idea here was to try to tie together a bunch of major and minor content mods to really integrate everything and make the playthrough seem more cohesive and less segregated. You'll see items from all of these mods in the bundle requirements in some shape or form, so to complete even a single bundle you'll be running around to all sorts of different parts of Stardew Valley, hopefully improving the immersion and cohesion.

But that's not all... there's another mod that's required as well, so you can get those sweet, sweet rewards.

[size=4]Completely Revamped Rewards:[/size]

All of the rewards have been ... completely removed?!? Well, not exactly. See, now every bundle rewards you with Prize Tickets. 3, in fact. It's set up this way because, with the exception of a handful of unique pieces of decor and clothing, every single reward in the Prize Machine has been completely overhauled! There are now [b]153 unique items in the Prize Machine[/b] to grab before things start repeating, starting out small and building up to huge rewards, culminating in a huge cross-mod reward of some of the hardest to find and most sought after items in the game. A certain Christmas present, perhaps? A very, very rare hat? A sapling from Mt. Vapius that you can't otherwise get? Some crops that, unless you've gone the Joja route, you've probably never seen? Powerful weapons, foods, and consumables? All that, and more. Prize Tickets from bundles combined with being a good Stardew citizen and helping out your neighbors means you'll be rolling in the loot!

Also, I welcome any translations to languages

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26998]Completionist's Complete Community Center[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24982]Prize Machine Custom Prizes[/url]﻿, as well as all 17 additional content mods and their respective dependencies. (Note 1: This mod requires most optional content in these mods to be enabled. Cornucopia extra packs, extra trees, Wildflour basic + advanced items, Alchemistry's optional Forage Crops mod and corresponding items, etc. Note 2: Be sure to update configuration settings in all installed mods to not modify bundle contents, as that will conflict with this mod. Note 3: Do not install the optional Custom Community Center Bundles dependency of the Completionist's mod, as it contains a separate set of custom bundles that conflicts with/overrides this mod.)﻿
[*]Download and unzip this mod into the [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
There are currently no configuration options available for this mod.

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.

It's mentioned above, but worth repeating the compatibility specifics:
[list=1]
[*]This mod requires most optional content in these mods to be enabled. Cornucopia extra packs, extra trees, Wildflour basic + advanced items﻿, Alchemistry's optional Forage Crops mod and corresponding items, etc.
[*]Be sure to update configuration settings in all installed mods to not modify bundle contents, as that will conflict with this mod.
[*]Do not install the optional Custom Community Center Bundles dependency of the Completionist's mod, as it contains a separate set of custom bundles that conflicts with/overrides this mod.
[/list]
[size=5]Credits
[/size]This mod contains a content pack for the Custom Community Cender Bundles, which was released with a GNU public license. I have included a copy of their work, also tagged with the appropriate licensing information, in this mod. Without their content, this mod would not be possible. A huge thank you and shout out to everyone that worked on that and released it free and open to use.
